Name: Nike Inc
Description: Nike, Inc. is a leading global athletic brand, headquartered in Beaverton, Oregon, recognized for its innovation in the design and manufacturing of footwear, apparel, and sports equipment. As the world's largest supplier of athletic shoes and apparel, Nike leverages its iconic brand portfolio and extensive marketing expertise to maintain a dominant position in the global sportswear market. Committed to sustainability and technological advancement, Nike continually enhances its product offerings, fostering brand loyalty and driving growth in diverse consumer segments worldwide. With a robust global supply chain and an increasingly digital sales strategy, Nike is well-positioned to capitalize on emerging trends in the athletic and lifestyle markets.
